answer: A payout is split so that 57% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The dune schedule is applied in pearl and knoll shows each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4284 identities would post 1617 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
